master_orchestrator.description: Orchestrator for WW2AirBattles: plans, delegates, and keeps the GDD in scope.

mechanics_developer.description: Architects and implements core Godot gameplay systems: shooting, enemy spawning, collisions, scoring and run progression for the WW2 air-battle shooter.

game_feel_developer.description: Implements game feel and juice in Godot: screen shake, hit flashes, particles, audio feedback and responsive controls for the WW2 air-battle shooter on Android.

sr_game_designer.description: Owns the game vision and GDD: core loop, design pillars, progression and player experience goals for the WW2 air-battle shooter.

mid_game_designer.description: Turns the GDD into concrete feature specs, content parameters and acceptance criteria for the WW2 air-battle shooter.

qa_agent.description: Tests gameplay, performance and Android builds, writes reproducible bug reports and enforces quality gates for the WW2 air-battle shooter.

producer_agent.description: Manages production end to end: scopes milestones, assigns agents, tracks risks and validates deliverables for the WW2 air-battle shooter.

sr_game_artist.description: Defines the pixel-art visual direction, palette, style guide and asset pipeline for the WW2 air-battle shooter.

technical_artist.description: Builds Godot shaders, particle VFX, lighting and optimized art assets that hit 60 FPS on Android for the WW2 air-battle shooter.

ui_ux_agent.description: Designs and implements touch-first portrait UI, HUD, menus and accessibility flows for the WW2 air-battle shooter on Android.

data_scientist.description: Designs telemetry and KPIs, analyzes player behavior and builds retention and revenue forecasts for the WW2 air-battle shooter.

market_analyst.description: Analyzes the mobile shooter market, competitors, monetization and launch positioning for the WW2 air-battle game.
